front.title: Post-Quantum Key Exchange with HQC in the Internet Key Exchange Protocol Version 2 (IKEv2)

abstract.t: This document specifies how to use Hamming Quasi-Cyclic (HQC), a code-based Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM), in the Internet Key Exchange Protocol Version 2 (IKEv2). HQC can be used alone or together with other key exchanges to derive IKE and Child SA keys that resist attacks by quantum computers. This document registers three Key Exchange Method identifiers.
